name: Used / secondary market: NVIDIA H100 80GB PCIe (bare card, ASKING band)
price_basis: USED-market ASKING prices, bare H100 80GB PCIe card only (part 900-21010-000-000), USD, observed 2026-10-03. NOT a sold price. Excludes tax/shipping, which the listing pages quote separately.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-picclick-ebay-asking. BAND OBSERVED, NOT A POINT ESTIMATE: n=8 qualifying bare-card listings, quartiles $40,880 (p25) / $43,000 (median) / $45,000 (p75), full observed range $32,000-$47,520. price_usd records the MEDIAN because a midpoint of a real distribution is defensible; the distribution is in notes because the spread is real. The $32,000 low outlier and the $45,000-$48,565 high cluster are both single listings, not a second market. Only 8 listings survive title filtering, so treat as indicative. CRITICAL SEPARATION: these are DATA-CENTER card asking prices. Do NOT compare against any GeForce figure in this repo - an RTX 4090 asking ~$3,300 and an H100 PCIe asking ~$43,000 are different products in different channels, and averaging them is the single worst error this record type invites.
